title: Service Management System
description: Full-stack web platform for managing tech repair services, clients and employees.
details: Designed and developed a complete system to manage repair services, automate manual registration, and reduce processing times. Built with a focus on intuitive UI/UX and efficient real-time data handling via Firebase.

title: PAR — Respiratory Rehabilitation Platform
description: Accessible web platform for respiratory therapeutic education and self-rehabilitation for post-COVID patients.
details: Collaborated with three universities on a user-centered PWA for respiratory rehabilitation. Designed accessible interfaces following WCAG 2.1, validated through CSUQ usability evaluations. Backed by 4 peer-reviewed publications.

title: Ludominga — Inclusive Learning Platform
description: Serious game platform for cognitive and emotional development in people with intellectual disabilities.
details: Contributed to the design and evaluation of an inclusive learning platform using the iPlus methodology and iterative user-centered design. Validated through usability testing with target users, demonstrating positive outcomes in engagement and learning.

title: Connect 4 — Multiplayer Game
description: Classic Connect 4 game with real-time multiplayer rooms built on a microservices architecture.
details: Recreated the classic board game with real-time multiplayer support using WebSockets and a microservices architecture. Demonstrates competency in Angular, Node.js and real-time communication patterns.

title: Body Metrics Estimation with CNN
description: Computer vision system that estimates height and weight from images using convolutional neural networks.
details: Trained a CNN model to predict physical attributes from images. Demonstrates applied machine learning skills including model training, image preprocessing with OpenCV, and performance evaluation.

title: Intelligent Pool Maintenance Agent
description: Autonomous agent for pool temperature monitoring and regulation using heuristic algorithms.
details: Implemented an autonomous agent that monitors and regulates pool temperature using heuristic decision-making algorithms. Explores AI agent design patterns and autonomous system behavior.

title: Car Dealership Management System
description: Fullstack CRUD platform for managing vehicle inventory, listings and dealership operations.
details: Built a complete CRUD application with search filters, inventory management and REST API integration. Developed to practice Angular architecture and API consumption patterns.

title: Vexillology Serious Game
description: Educational Unity game for learning world flags through interactive challenges.
details: Designed and developed an educational serious game for flag recognition using the iPlus methodology. Evaluated through usability testing with results rated between good and excellent. Backed by a peer-reviewed publication.
